settings.notes: Read-only market and outcome listing is implemented through the documented Augur v2 subgraph schema. Configure AUGUR_SUBGRAPH_URL or augur_subgraph_url to a maintained GraphQL endpoint. Prices, orderbooks, paper trading, live trading, and copy trading remain unsupported because no maintained official feed/order route is available.

Read-only games, conditions, odds, bettor bet history, WebSocket subscriptions, and local paper bet-calculation payloads are implemented through official Azuro APIs. Live posting only accepts pre-signed wallet order payloads and stays disabled by default.

Authenticated market discovery, runner listing, best-offer orderbooks, implied-probability prices, current/cleared account orders, funds/account/statement/currency-rate reads, local paper orders, and guarded placeOrders plus cancelOrders/updateOrders/replaceOrders support are implemented through Betfair's official Exchange and Accounts APIs. Order management requires betfair_order_management_enabled plus the shared live-safety gates and stays disabled by default; copy trading remains unsupported.

Official partner Sports API fixture, market, option, and implied-price reads plus local paper orders are implemented. Partner approval and AccessId/AccessIdToken are required; live betting and copy trading are unsupported because no order/account-activity endpoint is documented.

Official CME event-contract discovery, conids, top-of-book snapshots, executions/OHLC history, account order reads, guarded order cancellation/modification, alerts, paper orders, and IBKR Web API orders are implemented. An authorized IBKR session, CME/IBKR data and trading entitlements, and funded verification remain external gates.

Official Context v2 market, price, orderbook, alerts, paper-order, and guarded externally signed-order paths are implemented. Live use still requires a current API key, wallet setup, chain eligibility, and explicit safety gates.
Official anonymous read-only event, contract, and price access is implemented. An API key is optional for licensed tiers. Live trading, copy trading, and full orderbook depth are unsupported.

Read-only DraftKings Predictions/CDNA alias uses the official Crypto.com Predictions API for event, contract, and price data plus local paper orders. Anonymous reads are supported; an optional licensed API key may be supplied. CME-listed contracts use cme_prediction_markets. DraftKings account execution, orderbook depth, live trading, and copy trading are unsupported.

Official Drift Data API BET prediction reads, configured-symbol discovery, alerts, and dry-run orders are implemented. Configure drift_bet_market_symbols or DRIFT_BET_MARKET_SYMBOLS explicitly; the public OpenAPI contract has no stable market-list endpoint. Binary orderbooks, wallet-signed live orders, settlement, and copy trading remain unsupported.
Verified 2026-05-26: no public documented Fact Machine API/SDK or stable protocol integration contract suitable for app discovery, pricing, or order automation is published.

Read-only Fanatics Markets/CDNA alias using the official Crypto.com Predictions API for event discovery, contracts, prices, alerts, and local dry-run orders. Anonymous reads are supported; an optional licensed API key may be supplied. Fanatics-specific orderbook, live trading, and copy trading APIs are not published. Actual Fanatics account trading remains subject to KYC and regional eligibility.

Official ForecastEx event-contract discovery, conids, top-of-book snapshots, executions/OHLC history, account order reads, guarded order cancellation/modification, alerts, paper orders, and guarded buy-only IBKR Web API orders are implemented. An authorized IBKR session, ForecastEx permissions, and funded verification remain external gates.

Configured price-range grid discovery, BetSettled history, alerts, and dry-run EIP-712 BetIntent previews are implemented. Active quotes/oracle acknowledgements, wallet signing, orderbooks, live execution, and copy trading remain disabled.

Public prediction-market event discovery, contract listing, orderbooks, implied prices, local paper orders, guarded authenticated limit-order posting, and guarded single/batch order cancellation are implemented through official Gemini endpoints. Order management requires gemini_order_management_enabled plus the shared live-safety gates and exact operator confirmation; live trading stays disabled by default and copy trading remains unsupported.

Credentialed questions, answer probabilities, irregular forecast snapshots, local paper previews, and guarded forecast submission use the documented Cultivate Forecasts API. Set the instance base URL and credentials through environment variables; live submission remains disabled by default and is a forecast update, not exchange execution.

Official Hedgehog HPL Parimutuel/Eclipse MarketV1 accounts support on-chain discovery, pooled prices, alerts, dry-run DepositV1 intents, and a guarded submission boundary for externally signed DepositV1 transactions. Live submission remains off by default and requires reviewed program/market/option/amount metadata, wallet signing, and settlement handling. CLOB depth and copy trading remain unsupported.

Official HIP-4 outcome metadata, encoded outcome assets, orderbooks, wallet-scoped userFills/userFillsByTime trade history, open/historical orders, perpetual and spot account state, portfolio, subaccounts, alerts, paper orders, and simulation-first copy previews are implemented. Guarded signed cancel, cancel-by-cloid, modify, batch-modify, and schedule-cancel actions use the documented POST /exchange contract, remain disabled by default, and require a complete externally signed envelope plus shared live-safety confirmation. Set HYPERLIQUID_ACCOUNT_WALLET for account reads and HYPERLIQUID_TRADE_WALLET (or the legacy HYPERLIQUID_ACTIVITY_WALLET) for normalized history; the account reader falls back to the trade wallet when needed. Wallet signing, settlement, and funded execution remain external gates.
Verified 2026-08-21: API feeds are described as managed-service deliverables that require program access; no public API contract, SDK, or self-service endpoint is published.

Official IBKR ForecastTrader/ForecastEx event-contract discovery, conids, top-of-book snapshots, executions/OHLC history, account order reads, guarded order cancellation/modification, alerts, paper orders, and guarded buy-only IBKR Web API orders are implemented. An authorized IBKR session, account/data entitlements, and funded verification remain external gates.

Verified 2026-05-26; re-verified 2026-08-17: INFER-pub redirects to the RAND Forecasting Initiative permanent read-only archive; accounts and forecasting are closed, and no supported API or export contract is published.

contracts.P.NO: Powell's name is not placed in nomination

settings.notes: Archive-only support uses the official IEM historical price-file format; current quote pages, orderbooks, live trading, and copy trading remain unsupported.

Public question/market discovery, outcome price reads, orderbooks, alerts, bounded account_activity, portfolio, and market_positions reads from the public wallet endpoints, public wallet buy/sell activity, simulation-first copy intents, local paper quote payloads, guarded unsigned split/merge/redeem transaction intents, guarded HMAC/JWT-authenticated signed order submission, and fixed cancel/batch-cancel/cancel-all/batch-modify mutations are implemented through the official Myriad API. Position intents never sign or submit on-chain; live trading and order management stay disabled by default.

Official market/event discovery, prices/orderbooks, public trades, candles, signed account recovery, guarded live order placement, and guarded V2 cancel/batch-cancel/amend/decrease mutations are supported. Order management requires kalshi_order_management_enabled plus live_trading_enabled, live_trading_confirmed, and exact operator confirmation; live trading stays disabled by default and requires API key ID plus RSA private key material from environment variables or an external file.

Official market data, orderbooks, local paper trading, HMAC live order posting, and guarded single/batch/market-scoped cancellation are implemented through documented Limitless APIs. Live order management is disabled by default and requires limitless_order_management_enabled, live_trading_enabled, exact operator/global confirmations, and token credentials.

Official market discovery, probabilities, public manifold:<username> bet activity, authenticated /me and /bets account reads, simulation-first copy previews, local paper trading, and guarded open-limit bet cancellation are implemented through the official Manifold API. Authenticated MANA betting and order management are guarded by live_trading_enabled, separate opt-ins, exact confirmations, and MANIFOLD_API_KEY.

Authenticated read-only post/question discovery and probability reads are implemented through the official Metaculus API. Community Prediction data is access-limited by Metaculus API policy. No trading support exists.

Archive-only reads through SciCast's documented historical Data Mart: question discovery, forecast snapshots, trade history, alerts, and local paper previews. The service is retired; no orderbook, live trading, or copy trading is supported.

Authenticated market discovery, token listing, token prices, orderbooks, alerts, filled wallet-trade activity, order history/detail, and wallet positions use the official Opinion OpenAPI. Account reads require OPINION_ACCOUNT_WALLET (or the documented trade/activity wallet fallback) and OPINION_API_KEY. Guarded limit/market live orders plus cancel_order, batch_cancel_orders, and cancel_all_orders use the optional official opinion-clob-sdk on BNB Chain (chain id 56); install requirements-live.lock and provide OPINION_API_KEY, OPINION_PRIVATE_KEY, OPINION_MULTI_SIG_ADDRESS, and OPINION_RPC_URL only when explicitly enabling live trading or order management.

Read-only Nadex/CDNA prediction-event alias through the official Crypto.com Predictions Market Data API. Anonymous reads and local paper orders are supported; account trading, DCM/FIX depth, knock-out products, live orders, and copy trading are intentionally unsupported. Commercial redistribution/model training requires a Market Data License.

Market discovery, outcome listing, AMM marginal-price alerts, and local paper orders are implemented through the documented Omen FixedProductMarketMaker subgraph schema. Configure OMEN_SUBGRAPH_URL or omen_subgraph_url to a maintained GraphQL endpoint. Guarded live submission forwards only an externally signed buy/sell transaction after reviewed FPMM/side/outcome/calldata checks; it remains off by default and requires collateral approval and settlement handling.

Authenticated CLOB order/fill recovery and guarded cancel-order, cancel-orders, cancel-all-orders, and cancel-market-orders mutations are implemented through fixed official endpoints. Order management requires polymarket_order_management_enabled plus the shared live-safety gates and exact operator confirmation; live trading remains disabled by default. Keep credentials in .env or environment variables, not in config.json.
Public read-only market-data API support is implemented. Live trading/copy trading are unsupported because no official automation API is documented.

Market discovery, outcome listing, orderbook-derived prices, public order-match trade history, timeseries point-candles, authenticated account/order/activity/position recovery, local paper orders, and guarded signed order submission are implemented through the official Predict.fun REST API. Relay-only order removal is disabled by default, requires JWT credentials plus the shared live-safety gates and exact operator confirmation, and does not invalidate orders on-chain; copy trading remains unsupported.
Verified 2026-05-26: no public official PrizePicks developer API for programmatic projections, entries, market data, or automation is published for this app.
Verified 2026-05-26: Probo is a region-limited consumer opinion-market product and does not publish a public official API, SDK, or automation permission flow suitable for this app.

Read-only Robinhood Prediction Markets alias uses the official public Kalshi market-data API for discovery, contracts, prices, orderbooks, trades, candles, alerts, and local paper orders. Robinhood account execution, private endpoints, and copy trading are unsupported.

Official Smarkets v3 event, market, contract, quote-orderbook, alert, paper-order, authenticated order/account reads, and guarded session-authenticated order placement/cancellation are implemented. Application approval, written data-use permission, account eligibility, and funded execution remain external gates.

Read-only markets, active-order orderbooks, best odds, WebSocket channel metadata, and local paper trading are implemented through official SX Bet APIs. Live signed order posting is guarded by live_trading_enabled and requires wallet credentials plus funded SX account setup.

Official Thales AMM market/quote reads, positional prices, alerts, and local paper orders are implemented. Guarded live submission accepts only an externally signed transaction whose reviewed chain, AMM target, method, calldata, market, and position metadata match configuration; wallet signing, collateral approval, and settlement remain operator responsibilities.
Verified 2026-05-26: Underdog is a consumer app with eligibility restrictions and no public official API or automation terms for third-party prediction/event-market integration.

Authenticated market discovery, outcome listing, orderbooks, alerts, local paper orders, and guarded signed live order posting are implemented through official XO Markets HMAC endpoints. Live trading remains disabled by default; copy trading is unsupported.

Official Zeitgeist Subsquid/indexer market and asset discovery, outcome prices, alerts, and local paper orders are implemented. Guarded live forwarding accepts only an externally signed HybridRouter buy/sell extrinsic after reviewed market/asset/order metadata and runtime-version checks through zeitgeist_rpc_url; wallet signing, approvals, and settlement remain external and the gate is off by default.

Read-only Coinbase prediction-market alias over the official Kalshi venue market-data API for discovery, contracts, prices, orderbooks, alerts, and local paper orders. Coinbase-specific live and copy-trading APIs are not published; keep live trading disabled.

Official Probable market/CLOB discovery, prices, orderbooks, alerts, paper orders, and guarded externally signed-order submission are implemented. Live execution requires credentials, a signed order, BSC account readiness, and explicit opt-in.

Read-only Kalshi-through-Robinhood distribution alias uses the official public Kalshi market-data API for discovery, contracts, prices, orderbooks, trades, candles, alerts, and local paper orders. Robinhood account execution, private endpoints, and copy trading are unsupported.

Read-only FanDuel Predicts/OG alias using the official Crypto.com Predictions API for OG/CDNA event discovery, contracts, prices, alerts, and local dry-run orders. Anonymous reads are supported; an optional licensed API key may be supplied. CME-listed contracts remain available through cme_prediction_markets. FanDuel account orderbook, live trading, and copy trading APIs are not published; account use remains subject to KYC and regional eligibility.

Official Seer markets-search/get-market discovery, chain-qualified outcome prices, alerts, and local paper orders are implemented. Guarded live forwarding accepts only an externally signed transaction to an explicitly reviewed third-party DEX allow-list through seer_rpc_url; wallet signing, approvals, settlement, depth, and copy trading remain operator-owned or disabled.

Official DFlow nested event/market discovery, outcome mints, prices, orderbooks, alerts, paper trade requests, and guarded wallet-signed Solana transaction submission are implemented. Credentials, Proof/KYC, wallet, balance, redemption, and order-status evidence remain external gates.

Official Space REST reads, binary/multi-outcome contracts, prices, orderbooks, alerts, and local paper orders are implemented. The official docs currently say the public production release will be announced separately; wallet-signed live trading and copy trading remain unsupported.

Market discovery, outcome listing, orderbooks, prices, local paper orders, guarded API-key order submission, authenticated positions/order reads, and fixed batch create/cancel mutations are implemented through the official Xmarket API. Live trading and order management stay disabled by default; the latter additionally requires xmarket_order_management_enabled and the shared safety gates.

Official Base TruthMarketManager/TruthMarket and documented Uniswap pool reads, discovery, prices, alerts, paper orders, and guarded externally signed transactions are implemented. Live forwarding also requires an explicit reviewed target allow-list and exact decoded transaction/order metadata. CLOB depth and copy trading remain unsupported.

Official legacy Prediction-contract reads, bull/bear pool-share prices, alerts, and open-round paper intents are implemented. Configure the RPC and explicit deployed Prediction addresses; the adapter never guesses deployments. Live execution, CLOB depth, settlement, and copy trading remain unsupported.
Verified 2026-08-21: no stable official market-data and order API contract has been validated for SynStation.

Official Gnosis/Omen FixedProductMarketMaker GraphQL alias; configure a current Gnosis/Omen subgraph endpoint. Discovery, prices, alerts, paper orders, and a guarded externally signed buy/sell transaction boundary are supported; live submission remains off by default and CLOB depth, collateral approval, settlement, and copy trading remain unsupported.

The official Zeitgeist SDK/Markets Subsquid GraphQL schema is implemented as an explicit alias with independent discovery, outcome prices, alerts, and dry-run paper orders. The alias shares the guarded HybridRouter signed-extrinsic boundary and remains off by default; signing, settlement, CLOB depth, and copy trading remain external or unsupported.

Official MetaDAO Futarchy DEX /api/tickers discovery, bid/ask/last prices, alerts, and local paper orders are implemented. Guarded live forwarding accepts only an externally signed transaction to an explicitly reviewed Solana router allow-list through metadao_solana_rpc_url; wallet signing, approvals, settlement, depth, and copy trading remain operator-owned or disabled.
Verified 2026-08-21: Levr Bet's public model description does not provide a stable official API, deployment inventory, contract schema, or settlement fixtures for safe integration.

Verified 2026-08-21: Dexsport documents prediction markets and smart-contract settlement, but its public documentation does not provide a stable market-data API, deployment inventory, or reviewed prediction-contract ABI.

Official Lamas Finance Anchor PricePredict and UpOrDown programs are mapped to Solana JSON-RPC discovery, pooled prices, alerts, local paper intents, and a guarded externally signed predict boundary. The default deployment is the documented devnet example; confirm any production program/mint inventory before enabling it. CLOB depth, settlement, and copy trading remain unsupported.

Reviewed BSC PredictionMarket deployment and documented V2 contract model: on-chain discovery, pari-mutuel YES/NO pool prices, alerts, local paper intents, and guarded externally signed BUY transactions are fixture-backed. Keep market IDs explicit when operating a bounded inventory; live submission remains disabled by default and requires a reviewed target allow-list. CLOB depth, wallet signing, settlement, and copy trading remain unsupported.

Read-only alias over official Polymarket public market data for markets surfaced by Blinq. Discovery, contracts, prices, orderbooks, alerts, and local paper orders are supported; Blinq leverage, deposits, private account actions, live wallet execution, and copy trading remain unsupported.

Pool-scoped Zeitgeist market/pool/asset GraphQL adapter with guarded HybridRouter signed-extrinsic forwarding that requires reviewed pool_id metadata; the gate is off by default and pool accounting, settlement, signing, CLOB depth, and copy trading remain external or unsupported.

Official Reality.eth question-subgraph adapter; configure a current GraphQL endpoint. Question discovery, response-option listing, lifecycle alerts, and read-only metadata are supported. Prices, orderbooks, paper orders, and trading remain unsupported because Reality.eth is an oracle/question protocol.
Verified 2026-08-16: SportsTrade does not expose a validated public API contract for this app's market, quote, and order model.

Official ProphetX affiliate Market Data and guarded Trading API integration is implemented with offline fixtures, including wallet balance/transaction reads and fixed single/batch cancellation. Configure partner/API credentials; live submission and order management stay disabled by default, support the documented BUY quote shape only, require the separate prophet_exchange_order_management_enabled opt-in for cancellation, and require approved account/KYC/region access.
Verified 2026-08-16: Sporttrade product access and automation require a validated account/API contract that is not publicly available here.

Official Matchbook event/market/runner discovery, decimal-odds prices, orderbooks, alerts, paper orders, guarded session-authenticated offer submission, and fixed cancel/edit offer mutations are implemented. Account session, region eligibility, API terms, and funded execution remain external gates; order management is opt-in and disabled by default.
Verified 2026-08-16: Meta Arena is a game platform and does not expose a validated prediction-market API for this adapter model.
